title: My Brilliant Friend
author: Elena Ferrante
description: The first of Ferrante's Neapolitan novels — a fierce, intimate portrait of two girls growing up in postwar Naples, bound by a friendship that is loving, competitive, and impossible to escape.

title: The Book of Disquiet
author: Fernando Pessoa
description: An unfinished masterpiece of 20th-century literature: a dreamlike, fragmentary diary of a Lisbon bookkeeper wrestling with loneliness, identity, and the unbearable beauty of ordinary existence.

title: Anna Karenina
author: Leo Tolstoy
description: Tolstoy's towering novel of passion and consequence — a married aristocrat's doomed affair set against the glittering and hypocritical world of 19th-century Russian society.

title: The Namesake
author: Jhumpa Lahiri
description: A Bengali family navigates the gap between old-world tradition and American life across generations — a quiet, luminous novel about belonging, names, and the weight of identity.

title: Aram
author: Perumal Murugan
description: A Tamil novel exploring the meaning of dharma and righteous living — written by one of contemporary Tamil literature's most celebrated and fearless voices.
